reviewer: Same current agent; local pinned source reads only; no upstream code execution
contracts: ASCII labels require a rule,start0,export numbering=true and more than one original native node. Partial last paragraphs and one list plus ordinary paragraph are admitted; complete-list-item counts are absent.
Nonoutline indentation is four spaces per actual level unless native numbering margin delta and tab left are zero on an outline-level heading. Outline identity is the document reserved rule pointer.

Number strings come from the real number tree/rule and counted state. Empty bullet strings use the configured default character for the level, not custom display glyphs; uncounted/empty labels retain native blank behavior.
Writer defaults export numbering=true, clipboard=false,noLastLineEnd=false. Transfer sets clipboard=true. Existing UTF8 LF text range subset only.
GetNumString and HasVisibleNumberingOrBullet cover represented native defaults; NO_NUMBERING_SHOW_FOLLOWBY native false default is verified, optional compatibility configuration remains unsupported.

Margin delta and tab calculation read independent native masks and represented twip items, including legacy hanging/absolute spacing. Physical-line decomposition preserves existing list-item capture and visible label bodies.

Full attributes,fields,redlines,WriteAll/table clipboard topology,cursor rings,file export options,desktop environment/native compatibility and broad core/UI parity remain unverified. Prior statuses/defaults/classes and deliberate save/open/recovery deviations retained.
